annotations.title: Get a payment link for credits

description: Returns a payment link for a credit pack (pack_s 50, pack_m 150, pack_l 500 credits) or a plan (creator, pro, business; month or year). The person opens it, confirms on a Product Aura page and pays in Stripe; nothing is charged by this tool. Works without an account too: then it returns a link per pack, and the page after payment shows an API key.
name: buy_credits
